description: Image Description: The image displays a close-up of a freshly baked pizza, likely a Neapolitan-style pizza, served on a white plate. The crust is thick and slightly charred with prominent blackened spots, indicative of high-temperature baking in a wood-fired oven. The surface of the pizza is generously topped with melted mozzarella cheese that has browned slightly in spots, creating a golden-yellow hue. Thin slices of prosciutto are scattered across the top, adding a pinkish-red color
